incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO Alert: p99 latency breach on serving-cluster-3 (kv-cache pressure) - detected at 1837654321
Maya Patel: I'm on it, seeing alerts in pagerduty. p99 ~ 2.4s across 3 AZs.
Sanjay Rao: grabbing logs and dashboards now. Any impact to streaming?
Liam Chen: yes, streaming stalls reported, clients saw partial chunks then stalls around decode step.
Elena (eng-sre): confirmed elevated evictions on kv-cache; prefill rate >> decode consumption for some workloads. looks like fragmentation and small-object churn.
Maya Patel: please post the top metric panels (p95/p99, evictions/sec, prefill vs decode).
Sanjay Rao: quick snippets:```
# tail -n 50 /var/log/serving/runtime.log
[1837654301] INFO prefill: queued 1200 keys for session s-0a1
[1837654302] WARN kv: eviction triggered, freed 4MB
[1837654310] ERROR stream: stall at decode, shard-7
[1837654312] INFO latency: p95=320ms p99=2.3s
```
Liam Chen: looks like continuous prefill from many short sessions is saturating the slab allocator, causing fragmentation. small prefill objects preventing large decode entries from fitting -> extra paging.
Maya Patel: customer impact? are requests timing out or just slow? any 5xx?
Elena (eng-sre): 500s are minimal, mostly 504-ish streaming timeouts beyond 10s for clients that expect steady stream. We have ~1200 affected sessions in last 5m, top customer is corp-acme (approx 430 sessions).
Maya Patel: adding context in #incidents and pinging solutions. implement mitigations we discussed earlier: 1) short term: reduce prefill concurrency per-host, 2) increase kv-cache soft limit on cluster-3 if spare memory, 3) enable fallback to quantized-model for heavy traffic.
Sanjay Rao: running quick probe: `curl -s http://runtimes/cluster-3/metrics | jq '.kv_cache'` -> free_slots 120, total_slots 1024, eviction_rate 18/s, prefill_rate 42/s, decode_rate 12/s.
Liam Chen: prefill_rate >> decode_rate confirms imbalance. also see many small key allocations (~64B) causing fragmentation.
Elena (eng-sre): temp mitigation: bumped soft_limit +15% on node-pool-3a, disabled client-side aggressive prefill flag for incoming SDK traffic via rate-limit rule (applied).
Maya Patel: rolling restart of a few hot serving pods to defragment? risk of disruption though.
Liam Chen: prefer to avoid restarts during peak. Instead: apply allocation policy change to prefer contiguous allocations for decode-sized objects (`kv.alloc.hint=contiguous`) - safe to toggle?
Elena (eng-sre): toggling allocation hint is low-risk on runtime. I'll flip on pool-3 within 30s.
Sanjay Rao: pushing config: `rbacctl set config serving/cluster-3 kv.alloc.hint=contiguous --apply`; patch queued.
Maya Patel: monitoring p99 and streaming error rate. readable dashboards: https://console.redwood/serving/cluster-3/dashboards/kv-cache
incident-bot: Handoff: oncall shift change scheduled. @Maya Patel handing to @Liam Chen in 10m.
Maya Patel: Liam, I'll shadow for next 10m then sign off. currently p99 dropped to 1.1s after soft_limit bump and rate-limit on prefill. eviction_rate down to 6/s. streaming stalls still present but reduced.
Liam Chen: taking over. I'll keep watch and prepare a targeted mitigation: temporarily disable prefill for SDK clients with `prefill_mode=on_request` for next 15m.
Elena (eng-sre): done. applied rule: `prefill_mode=on_request` for client_tag=sdk-beta.
Sanjay Rao: also routing a small % (5%) of requests to fallback quantized model via smart-routing to reduce memory pressure. Routing rule id: route-qs-1843.
Liam Chen: good. p95 now ~180ms, p99 ~720ms, eviction_rate 3/s, prefill_rate 10/s, decode_rate 14/s. streaming timeouts dropped by ~60%.
Maya Patel: customer comms: classify impact as degraded latency, potential stream timeouts for heavy sessions. recommend proactive email to top 10 customers in 1hr if we don't fully stabilize.
Elena (eng-sre): logging a short incident summary in incidents channel and creating a follow-up ticket: `INC-183765` with root cause hypothesis: kv-cache fragmentation due to high prefill concurrency and many small allocations. action items: compaction strategy, revision of prefill defaults, metric alert tuning.
oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident acknowledged and ticket INC-183765 created.
Liam Chen: I'll keep the thread updated. tagging @SRE to do a postmortem if we hit repeat in 24h.
Maya Patel: thanks team. signing off now. :wave:
Liam Chen: thanks Maya. continuing monitoring; will escalate if p99 rises above 1.5s.
end of thread
